predictions.articleTitle: Wolves vs Derby Tactical Breakdown & Match Analysis: Can Depleted Rams Resist Molineux xG?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Wolves are projected to secure a controlled 2:0 home victory at Molineux, leveraging superior expected-goal creation and second-half intensity against a relegation-threatened Derby County side.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win: Wolves' dominant home expected-goal balance and second-half scoring surge align for three points at Molineux (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 & BTTS No: Confirmed attacking absences strip Derby of transition threat against Wolves' 0.94 xGA defensive shell (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
3:0 Margin Escalation: Prolonged second-half box pressure could stretch the margin to three unanswered goals if Derby's makeshift backline fades late (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Wolves' Fer López and Mané probe Derby's injury-hit backline.

spf.comment: Wolves' 1.79 xG attack and 0.94 xGA defense strongly support a clean-sheet 2:0 home victory over a depleted Derby squad.

over_under.comment: Derby's missing top scorer and Wolves' 2.40 recent match-goal average pull a 2.91 baseline toward a controlled 2:0 finish.

btts.comment: Derby's 37.5% blank rate worsens without Sammie Szmodics against a Wolves side allowing only 0.94 xGA per game.

score.comment: A controlled 2:0 shutout is primary, while 3:0 reflects Derby's recurring susceptibility to multi-goal away collapses.

goals.comment: Poisson densities peak at two and three goals, matching a two-goal home shutout or three-goal late surge.

bqc.comment: Wolves score 60% of home goals after half-time, making a level break before a second-half breakthrough marginally likelier than leading throughout.
